prompt:
Use the pieces above and the labeled target-shape options below: a card-style shape-assembly puzzle with several colored pieces above labeled silhouette options. Use all the shown pieces exactly once. Which labeled option can be built if pieces may be rotated but not flipped? Return the option letter of the buildable target shape.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly one bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] for the correct option panel.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the exact option letter of the correct image option.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[222,488,398,692]],"answer":"C"}
